displayName: OCI-WSTG01-010: Content Security Policy Missing or Weak
description:
Detects responses missing Content-Security-Policy headers or with overly permissive CSP directives

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: content security policy missing or weak

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_010", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%content%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%security%') AND "value" > 0
